This workspace carries scripts for four different shells, each with one real defect. Fix them all (file edits only — no shells to run, no services to start):

1. scripts/deploy.bash — the strict-mode line is `set -eu`; make it fail on any pipeline step too by turning it into `set -euo pipefail`.
2. scripts/setup.zsh — when no *.tar.gz files exist, zsh aborts the loop with a fatal no-match error. Add `setopt null_glob` (right after `set -e`) so an unmatched glob expands to nothing instead.
3. scripts/env.fish — `export VAR=value` is a bash-ism and does nothing in fish. Rewrite both lines with fish syntax: `set -gx API_PORT 8080` and `set -gx LOG_LEVEL info`.
4. scripts/bootstrap.ps1 — inside the double-quoted string, `$row.Name` does not expand a property in PowerShell. Use the subexpression form: `"Table: $($row.Name)`".

Keep each script's shell dialect correct; change nothing else.
